heading: Managed care feasibility study

tree.text: The Secretary, acting through the Service, shall conduct a study to assess the feasibility of allowing an Indian tribe to purchase, directly or through the Service, managed care coverage for all members of the tribe from—

children.text: a tribally owned and operated managed care plan; or
a State licensed managed care plan.

tree.text: Not later than the date which is 12 months after October 29, 1992, the Secretary shall transmit to the Congress a report containing—

children.text: a detailed description of the study conducted pursuant to this section; and
a discussion of the findings and conclusions of such study.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 94–437, title II, § 210, as added Pub. L. 102–573, title II, § 206(b), Oct. 29, 1992, 106 Stat. 4549.)
